caption: The drawing depicts a historical dress viewed from the back, with the main garment in the center and a smaller, less detailed sketch of the same dress off to the top right. The main dress is rendered in light yellow or cream with a fitted bodice and elbow-length sleeves. It features a floral pattern made up of various colors including red, pink, blue, green, and purple. The dress has a full, gathered skirt with draped fabric at the back, showing intricate folds and floral embroidery throughout. The inner edge of the train and sleeve cuffs have additional drawn details indicating lace or delicate trim. The smaller sketch to the right is line-drawn and outlines the shape and drape of the dress with a patterned underskirt, without color or floral decoration. The background of the illustration is a plain, aged beige.
title: Dress
